author: J484948
quote: Disappointed is not a word that comes close! I could go into detail about the very obvious use of  ludonarrative dissonance and the forced compliance to give it an illusion of choice and the clear feminising unhealthy toxic relationship promoting agenda behind the writing and I could go into detail about how awful the characters and the storyline are however too many people have covered it already. But one thing people are not talking about is how terrible the controls, graphics and performance actually is! Blurry, grainy, delayed and the colours are washed! New Xbox with all settings configured correctly, I spent more time trying to fix the awful look of the game rather than playing. Within minutes of playing the audio broke, the map glitched out and didn’t load and the characters had no shape. I spent 10 minutes on the game before deciding to request a refund! I’m truly appalled it released in such a state. Rockstar games do not care about the backlash or negativity, they brush it off because of revenue and profits which is all they care about now. They have become everything the company stood against and the franchise of Grand Theft Auto has come to an evident end! Rest in peace GTA, Rest in peace Rockstar “games”. This game is the equivalent to a pump and dump **** coin. God awful, I’d rather burn in hell for eternity whilst being tortured by satanic elephants than play ts absolute slop
